## History

Bentley served as the pastor of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for eighteen years, though [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) notably found him lacking in imagination. A widower during his entire time in the community, he eventually resigned his charge in February and departed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) accompanied by the regrets of his congregation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)_
